title: Liapoldus Gateway traffic runtime boundary
trafficConfiguration: Native Caddyfile fragments in group revisions; Gateway does not define a route DSL.
runtime: Compatible Caddy handles HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS, reverse proxy, static serving, WebSocket, SSE and ACME.
l4: Caddy-L4 handles TCP/UDP relay and direct plugin streams; mandatory conformance applies to embedded and external Caddy variants.

pluginDataProtocol.call: Caddy Liapoldus handler calls the plugin directly using existing versioned JSON contracts.
pluginDataProtocol.routeBinding: Native Caddyfile handler binds instance, capability and invocation mode; Manifest declares supported modes and Gateway validates before activation.
pluginDataProtocol.externalDispatch: Gateway supervises external Caddy and synchronizes an authenticated immutable dispatch snapshot over private local Admin API/IPC.

activation: Gateway validates and prepares one complete composition from all active group revisions before activating it. Failed activation leaves the previous snapshot and current/previous pointers unchanged.
adminApi: Native Caddy Admin API is loopback/local IPC only. External requests use authenticated Gateway pass-through with checkpointing and drift protection.
frontends: Frontend files are immutable roots bundled into the same group revision as its Caddyfile fragment.
